name: Cindy Griffin Basketball Camps
description_short: Week long summer basketball camps at Saint Joseph's University's Hagan Arena: a coed morning camp for ages 5 to 8 and a full day fundamentals camp for girls 9 to 14, built around skill stations, drills and games.

sessions.name: Junior Hawks Camp (coed, ages 5 to 8, 9 AM to 12 PM)
Fundamental Day Camp (girls, ages 9 to 14, 9 AM to 3 PM, ends at noon Friday)

notes: Both camps include a camp T shirt. The one evening High School Elite Camp (June 25, 2027, $150) is a clinic and is not listed. Saint Joseph's athletics page (sjuhawks.com camps and clinics) links here; its other summer offerings are one day prospect clinics or short sport camps.
